answer: The binder winds the rope truss round the raised barrel, and the truss must pull the staves tight before the hoops go on. Keg cedar cooper cask warrant covers the binding: a warrant cedar coopers hold after cooperage reviews. First comes the zenith, wound at dawn; then the river, wound before the hoops are driven; the walnut is the rope itself, tarred and strong. A cheat must wind 79 false trusses and drive 79 false hoops.
